scoring_justification: Tc values are recomputed from the agent's reported ΔE using the Ising model formula; ΔE values are compared to paper-reported gold with tolerance.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference ΔE and Tc values from the paper (K/La doping at 12.5% and 25%)
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text: ΔE ≈ 15, 51 meV/Mn for K, 34, 64 meV/Mn for La; Tc ≈ 327, 453 K for K/La at 25% (Table 1 and text).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper's reported values
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the published numbers the checker compares against; they are the ground truth defined by the paper.

K_12.5.description: Energy difference per Mn in meV for K doping at 12.5%

K_25.description: Curie temperature in K for K doping at 25%

La_25.description: Curie temperature in K for La doping at 25%

outputs.description: Reproduced energy differences and Curie temperatures. The hidden checker compares delta_E values to the paper's reference values with appropriate tolerances, recomputes Tc from delta_E using J1=ΔE/4 and the 2D Ising relation, and verifies that both Tc exceed 300 K.

output_contract.notes: The checker combines a reference-match on ΔE with a derived threshold check on Tc. Ensure all ΔE values are in meV/Mn and Tc values in K.

steps.description: Score energy differences and Curie temperatures
